title: DVDs
summary: DVDs (Digital Versatile/Video Discs) are home media releases that preceded online streaming. The first season of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers was released on DVD in several different countries including the US and Italy. Season 2 was not released on physical DVD but both seasons were eventually available to watch on numerous streaming platforms including Netflix, HappyKids.TV, Kidoodle and, most recently, the official Huntik YouTube Channel.

full_text:
DVDs (Digital Versatile/Video Discs) are home media releases that preceded online streaming. The first season of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers was released on DVD in several different countries including the US and Italy. Season 2 was not released on physical DVD but both seasons were eventually available to watch on numerous streaming platforms including Netflix, HappyKids.TV, Kidoodle and, most recently, the official Huntik YouTube Channel. 

== Countries ==
Officially licensed Huntik DVDs have been released in the following countries:
*UK
*US
*Italy
*Germany 
*Australia
*New Zealand

== List of DVDs ==

UK/US=
The only DVD of the English dub to be released in the UK was the bonus DVD included with the Huntik Trading Card Game Starter Deck by Upper Deck. It was also released in the US on the same date, becoming the first DVD of the franchise to be released.
